We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Employment Type: Full-time

	We are seeking an experienced and strategic Female Human Resources Manager to lead the organization's HR function.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing HR strategies, overseeing talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compliance, and fostering a high-performance work culture aligned with business objectives.

	Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and strategic initiatives.
	Lead recruitment, onboarding, talent management, and succession planning.

	Coordinate learning and development programs to enhance employee performance and organizational growth.

	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related discipline.

  "title": "Executive Assistant",
  "description": "Work Dey HR Services offers a wide range of HR Consulting Services to Organizations and Individuals. We match Suitable andemployable applicants to Genuine Vacancies in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant
Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and tech-savvy Executive Assistant to provide high level administrative, operational, and strategic support to the CEO of a fast-growing e-commerce brand in Nigeria.
	The ideal candidate will serve as the CEO&rsquo;s right hand, ensuring smooth day to day operations, managing priorities, coordinating projects, handling confidential information, and enabling the CEO to focus on business growth and strategic decision-making.
	This role requires exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, strong attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities
Executive &amp; Administrative Support:


	Manage the CEO&rsquo;s daily schedule, calendar, and appointments
	Coordinate meetings, both virtual and physical
	Schedule internal and external meetings while avoiding conflicts
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly schedules
	Organize reminders for meetings, deadlines, birthdays, and important business events
	Handle all travel arrangements including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries
	Screen phone calls and correspondence where necessary
	Prepare agendas before meetings
	Take meeting minutes and ensure follow-up on action items
	Organize confidential documents and maintain digital filing systems
	Manage business records and important company documents
	Draft letters, reports, proposals, and presentations.


Email &amp; Communication Management:


	Monitor and manage the CEO&rsquo;s email inbox
	Prioritize emails requiring urgent attention
	Respond to emails on behalf of the CEO when appropriate
	Follow up with clients, vendors, suppliers, partners, and stakeholders
	Maintain professional communication at all times
	Coordinate WhatsApp, phone calls, and other communication channels
	Ensure prompt responses to important inquiries.


Operational Support:


	Assist in managing the daily operations of the company
	Coordinate between departments to ensure smooth workflow
	Track ongoing projects and deadlines
	Ensure assigned tasks are completed on time
	Monitor operational bottlenecks and recommend improvements
	Prepare operational reports for the CEO
	Assist with implementing new systems and processes


Project Management:


	Assist the CEO in planning and executing projects
	Monitor project timelines and deliverables
	Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors
	Prepare progress reports
	Follow up with responsible team members until projects are completed
	Keep project documentation organized.


Social Media &amp; Instagram Management:


	Assist in managing the company&rsquo;s Instagram and other social media platforms
	Schedule and publish content
	Coordinate content creation with designers and content creators
	Identify trends and suggest content ideas.


Customer &amp; Client Relationship Support:


	Coordinate communication with VIP customers
	Handle client follow-ups
	Schedule meetings with business partners
	Maintain client databases
	Ensure excellent customer relationship management
	Assist in resolving escalated customer issues.


Research &amp; Strategic Support:


	Conduct market research
	Research competitors and industry trends
	Prepare reports and summaries
	Gather data for business decisions
	Research potential partnerships
	Identify new business opportunities
	Stay informed about e-commerce trends in Nigeria and globally


Event &amp; Meeting Coordination:


	Organize company meetings
	Coordinate workshops and training sessions


Personal Assistance:


	Assist with selected personal errands where necessary
	Coordinate appointments
	Manage personal reminders
	Handle confidential personal matters professionally
	Assist in balancing business and personal schedules
	Make reservations and bookings when required


Reporting &amp; Performance Tracking:


	Generate weekly progress reports
	Compile monthly business summaries
	Monitor task completion rates
	Maintain executive dashboards


Confidentiality &amp; Professionalism:


	Handle confidential company information with discretion
	Maintain strict confidentiality regarding company operations
	Demonstrate professionalism in all interactions
	Represent the CEO positively at all times
	Exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive matters


Required Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Exceptional organizational skills
	Strong multitasking ability
	Excellent written and verbal communication
	High attention to detail
	Strong problem-solving skills
	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
	Ability to prioritize effectively
	Excellent time management
	Strong interpersonal skills
	High level of integrity and discretion
	Ability to work under pressure
	Adaptability in a fast-paced environment
	Strong leadership and coordination skills
	Professional appearance and demeanor
	Critical thinking and sound decision-making abilities


Technical Skills:
Candidates should be proficient in:


	Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Drive, Gmail)
	Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
	Canva
	Instagram Business tools
	WhatsApp Business
	Zoom and Google Meet
	Trello, Asana, ClickUp, or similar project management software
	Notion
	Slack
	Basic spreadsheet reporting and data analysis
	Basic CRM systems
	AI productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT or similar platforms).


Preferred Qualifications


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field
	Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Administrative Manager
	Experience working with founders, executives, or CEOs is highly preferred
	Experience in an e-commerce, retail, or digital business environment is an advantage.


Personal Attributes:
The ideal candidate should be:


	Highly proactive rather than reactive
	Trustworthy and dependable
	Professional and well-spoken
	Resourceful and solution-oriented
	Calm under pressure
	Organized and detail-oriented
	Flexible and adaptable
	Positive with a can-do attitude
	Committed to continuous learning and self-improvement
	Passionate about business growth and operational excellence.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 per month.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: career.wsl@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",
